newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CAM completes stake sale in Aero-Green.
newsitem.headline: CAM completes stake sale in Aero-Green.

text.p: CAM International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had completed the sale of a 49-percent stake in Aero-Green Technology (S) Pte Ltd to the Sime Darby Group for Singapore $10.88 million.
Aero-Green is the pioneer in the large-scale commercial production of aeroponic vegetables in Singapore, the precision engineering company statement said.

Under the agreement, first announced in April 21, 1997, Consolidated Plantations Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sime, acquired 2.94 million Aero-Green shares for $7.94 million and further subscribed for another 2.94 million shares at S$1 par.
After the sale, CAM said its subsidiary CAM Agro-Innovation (S) Pte Ltd (CAI) will operate Aero-Green as a joint venture with Consolidated Plantations.
CAI will hold 51 percent stake in Aero-Green while Consolidated Plantation the remaining 49 percent.

Separately CAM, which is under fraud allegation investigation by Singapore's Commercial Affairs Department, said it was reviewing the contents of a Price Waterhouse's report to determine the necessary course of action for the company.
It said it was also holding meetings with its banks and customers.
Auditors Price Waterhouse was appointed by CAM to assess the financial impact from matters raised in a special audit review report on the company and some subsidiaries.
